spans.s:
The affix घ comes in the sense of a descendant after the word क्षत्र।

Terms: घ

In क्षय्य and जय्य there is substitution of अय् for ए only then when the sense is that of 'to be possible to do'.

Terms: संहितायाम्

The word क्षय has the acute on the first syllable and on the last syllable at one and the same time.

Terms: accent-word

The अ of the Aorist characteristic कस् is elided before an affix beginning with a vowel.

Terms: कस् affix

म is substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root क्षै।

Terms: निष्ठा changes
